item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 04e7559 / d93fdf9 / 47cdd58e named, the base and head arms and the negative control recorded with log paths, and measurement_module naming the base scratch copy of reckon/followup_pointers.py.

justifications.durability: the negative control restores the bare section token and reddens 10 ids in tests/test_the_invocation_parser_spells_a_section.py including the dotted and hyphenated pins, and the head assertions compare parse_invocation's output against the literal s5-1 and None rather than against a value the test supplied.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's base-gate.log (184 passed EXIT=0) and head-gate.log (196 passed EXIT=0) record the measure, negative-control.log records the mutation at EXIT=1, and the independent re-run of tests/test_the_invocation_parser_spells_a_section.py returned 12 passed EXIT=0, though head-gate.log's header names the implementation revision 04e7559 while the reviewed head is the records-only commit 47cdd58e.
justifications.fit: reckon/followup_pointers.py:38 imports the shared core rather than re-declaring the number grammar, the module docstring states the boundary rule, and the commits carry conventional subjects with bodies, though the source-token count at tests/test_the_invocation_parser_spells_a_section.py:178 pins an implementation detail rather than a behaviour.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/followup_pointers.py:60 composes the token from SECTION_NUMBER_PATTERN and reckon/followup_pointers.py:102 routes the capture through section_record_id, so 5.1 and 5-1 become s5-1 and 5a becomes no section, exactly what the goal states.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no production definition and extends the existing owner reckon/_plan_html.py:63, using SECTION_NUMBER_PATTERN and section_record_id rather than forking a parallel section-number grammar.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only e853f22d..47cdd58e returns only reckon/followup_pointers.py, tests/test_the_invocation_parser_spells_a_section.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths, and the change adds nothing the goal does not imply.
